Most businesses aren't short on information. They're short on a way to organize it.

Long documents, crowded presentations, complicated charts and unfamiliar terminology can bury the most important idea. A custom whiteboard explainer video turns that information into a clear visual story — one idea at a time.

Our latest article breaks down how strategy, scriptwriting, custom illustration and animation work together to make complex ideas easier to understand and remember.

Read it here: https://www.gholmesdesigns.com/post/explain-it-clearly-make-it-memorable?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=organic_social&utm_campaign=explain_it_clearly&utm_content=launch

What part of your business is the hardest to explain?

#ExplainItClearly #WhiteboardExplainer

Expertise doesn't automatically translate into clarity.

You may understand your service, process or organization completely. Your audience doesn't have the same context.

When the explanation depends on long documents, crowded presentations, disconnected graphics or specialized terminology, the most important idea becomes hard to identify. The information arrives. The understanding doesn't.

A custom whiteboard explainer video organizes that information into a structured visual story — one idea at a time.

Our latest article examines how strategic scripting, storyboarding, custom illustration and animation make complex messages easier to understand and remember.

Clear communication takes more than cutting a few paragraphs. It takes deciding what the audience needs to understand, how the supporting information connects, and what action should follow.

An effective explainer video doesn't begin with animation.

It begins with deciding what the audience needs to understand.

At G.Holmes Designs, the process runs:

Strategy → Scriptwriting → Storyboarding → Custom Illustration → Animation → Final Production

Every stage removes information that isn't earning its place, organizes what's left, and points the audience at the central message.

See how the full process works: https://www.gholmesdesigns.com/post/explain-it-clearly-make-it-memorable?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=organic_social&utm_campaign=explain_it_clearly&utm_content=process

Which stage do you think matters most to the finished video?

#ExplainItClearly #ExplainerVideo

Animation isn't the first step in producing an effective explainer video.

It's the execution of decisions made much earlier.

The process starts with three questions:

What does the audience need to understand?
What information supports that central idea?
What should the viewer do next?

Those answers drive the script, the storyboard, the custom illustration, the animation and the final production.

When every stage serves the same communication objective, the video stops being attractive content and becomes a tool for explaining the message the same way every time.

The same core message can support:

• A website service page

• A sales presentation

Shorter edits, alternate aspect ratios and platform-specific versions extend the useful life of the original production without changing its central story.

That makes it a flexible communication asset rather than a one-time deliverable.
